answer: PoA assigns reputation an exponential temporal half-life, requiring sustained honest service to preserve influence rather than rewarding short-lived activity. A freshly spawned Sybil identity starts with near-zero EigenTrust eigenvector centrality; without trusted reciprocal edges, reciprocity-weighted transitivity cannot carry its claims through the matrix or into consensus. Thus a coordinated spiral of new accounts gains little traction: a jetty cannot launch a voyage on borrowed credibility alone.
